html.title: SFRJ 1990: Last Federation
boot.errorLead: Serve the folder over HTTP (browsers block fetch from file://):
title.sub: The last year the federation could still choose paperwork over war
title.pitch: You sit on the federal command layer while six republics and two provinces enter the first multi-party year. Peace-time only through 15 May 1991.
title.disclaimer: Not a war game. June 1991 and later are not in this build. Real deaths are not a score.
ency.attentionBody: Reforms and desks share one monthly attention pool (3; 4 if SIV authority ≥ 60).
ency.e3pathBody: E3 needs an open charter (≥4 signatures) and a Presidency that can still meet. Seating Mesić ≠ deadlock. Izetbegović–Gligorov is June 1991 — not on the April card.
e3.rule: E3 requires an open confederal charter and a Presidency that can still meet; seating Mesić keeps the chair filled, deadlock is a stall and blocks E3.
